objectives.prompt: Research {domain} and report at most 3 evidence-backed market-gap survivors after active falsification. Do not pad the result.
Inspect the competitor and substitute landscape for {domain}; identify feature, workflow, customer, pricing, and positioning overlap before naming any whitespace.
Find pricing gaps and real spending or willingness-to-pay signals in {domain}; separate prices, labor spend, and inferred budget.
Mine recurring customer pain, workarounds, churn reasons, and requested outcomes in {domain}; require independent signals and named buyers.
Research failed, discontinued, or abandoned attempts serving {domain}; test whether the historical blocker still exists before proposing a resurrection.
Test whether regulation, technology, distribution economics, or market change creates a credible now-reason in {domain}.
Find opportunities in {domain} reachable through a specific existing channel and reject ideas whose buyers cannot be named or reached.
Falsify and validate a proposed workflow-automation idea for {domain}; return one next-best action with success and kill criteria.
Identify observable business-level buying signals in {domain}, including manual work, poor reviews, outdated systems, compliance burden, hiring, or rapid growth.
Start with {domain}; if the niche is saturated or weak, branch into adjacent segments, workflows, verticals, geographies, or business models until a survivor passes or the hard budget is exhausted.
